title: Helianthus eeBUS MCP v1 raw feature acquisition profile

x-secret-boundary.keyNormalization: Unicode NFKC; insert underscore at ASCII lower-or-digit to upper transition; map every run outside [A-Za-z0-9] to underscore; lowercase; collapse and trim underscores
x-secret-boundary.keyComparison: exact normalized or underscore-elided match against x-secret-denylist
x-secret-boundary.valueNormalization: Unicode NFKC then trim leading and trailing whitespace
valueRejection: case-insensitive bearer authorization scheme followed by a non-empty credential

FeatureDataGetDataV1.x-invariant: complete is true exactly when failures is empty and every requested target has one result

EnvelopeV1.x-invariant: oneOf binds tool, scope, auth_scope, request, data, and success/error exclusivity; partial_result is the only data-plus-error variant
